mechanism: Indomethacin may reduce renal clearance of isoniazid and potentially inhibit its metabolism, while isoniazid may induce CYP450 enzymes affecting indomethacin metabolism; NSAIDs also increase hepatotoxicity risk when combined with isoniazid.
action: Monitor liver function tests and isoniazid levels; consider alternative analgesic if possible; counsel on hepatotoxicity signs; ensure adequate hydration to maintain renal function.
